failure_modes.name: Pump seal leakage
failure_modes.description: Synthetic failure mode representing loss of containment near the pump seal.
symptoms: Visible liquid trace near the seal area
Increasing vibration during the affected window
Falling outlet pressure during the affected window
possible_causes: Synthetic seal installation or alignment issue
recommended_checks: Confirm that the visible trace is not residual cleaning fluid
Compare pressure and vibration over the same observation window
Request inspection by a qualified maintainer
failure_modes.source: KNOW-PUMP-MANUAL / Seal leakage indicators (synthetic demo source)

failure_modes.name: Motor bearing fault
failure_modes.description: Synthetic failure mode representing a localized motor bearing condition.
symptoms: Increasing bearing temperature while current remains in its normal band
possible_causes: Synthetic bearing wear or mechanical misalignment
recommended_checks: Preserve the measurement window and confirm sensor units
Request inspection by a qualified maintainer
failure_modes.source: KNOW-MOTOR-MANUAL / Bearing fault indicators (synthetic demo source)
